## Checklist

- [ ] Entry or entries added/updated under `entries/<topic>/`, one commit each
- [ ] Frontmatter complete (title, summary, tags, date, confidence)
- [ ] Ran `python scripts/build_index.py` per commit, committed `INDEX.md`
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, internal hostnames, or proprietary
      business details
- [ ] Checked `INDEX.md`, not a near-duplicate of an existing entry
